confidence_notes: Recent Numbeo city averages give food and beer anchors, but the sample is limited and its latest update is 3 October 2026, so July pricing is approximate. Cocktail and restaurant wine estimates are inferred from local beer prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied comparables; no booking prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cusco is a major visitor hub with stronger tourism demand than Paracas, Ollantaytambo, and Huacachina, while its accommodation market remains in a similar Peru price band. I place its three-star rooms near Lima and the smaller tourist destinations, and its basic rooms and hostel options somewhat above the lower-priced comparables.
